title: Tickets, Trains and Trouble
label: ch:hi-tickets-trains-and-trouble
canDo: I can buy a ticket and ask when the next train leaves (aglī ṭren kitne baje calegī?), and report a lost bag or a missed train (merā thailā kho gayā, merī ṭren chūṭ gaī).

payoff.summary: Complete HI-R283-at-the-station: buy a ticket, ask about the next train, and report what went wrong.
